$comment: Frozen inputs of the 0.16.0 ledger (hds#462), read by scripts/upgrade/build-ledger.mjs. 0.16.0 shipped before ledgers existed, so its record was written after the fact from its snapshot (docs/api/releases/0.16.0.json) and its CHANGELOG section. Each CHANGELOG.md:<line> is numbered as the file read when 0.16.0 shipped (its section starts on line 3); its needle names the commit of the entry and is the text that finds the line.
